device.description: 8-bit multiplying current-output DAC with 8-bit parallel input latch (CS, WR)
device.note: tlc7524.pdf (SLAS061D) p.1 (D/N/PW pinout, description), p.2 (functional block diagram), p.3 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 4.75-5.25 V and 14.5-15.5 V, input levels, CS/WR/data timing; Figure 1 timing), p.6 (principles of operation: CS and WR latch control), p.7 (Tables 1-2 unipolar / bipolar coding)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: data latch: transparent while CS and WR are low, latched when either goes high (p.6); power-on code not stated

commands.name: Write (CS and WR low)
commands.note: data latched when CS or WR goes high (p.6)

pages: p.1 (D/N/PW pinout, description), p.2 (functional block diagram), p.3 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 4.75-5.25 V and 14.5-15.5 V, input levels, CS/WR/data timing; Figure 1 timing), p.6 (principles of operation: CS and WR latch control), p.7 (Tables 1-2 unipolar / bipolar coding)
notModeled: analog: multiplying current outputs OUT1/OUT2, reference REF (+-10 V), feedback resistor RFB, 2-/4-quadrant multiplication
power-on state of the data latch is not stated in the datasheet (0 used)
the latch is level-transparent while CS and WR are low (output follows the data bus); the model latches at the end of the write
input logic levels at VDD = 15 V (VIH 13.5 V) differ from 5 V TTL levels
the pinout drawing names D, N and PW; the NS (SOP) package is assumed to use the same 16-pin numbering; the FN (PLCC-20) package has no orderable part here
variants: tlc7524.pdf covers TLC7524C/E/I (temperature grades), same interface.
